sections.text: Light God of the Staff XL

[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Mage/Berserker/Treasure Hunter:
Physical and magic Ability Power increases by XL - 5XL based on the light elemental attack value.

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Mage/Berserker/Treasure Hunter.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate against Dark enemies increases to L+.
